source_candidate.title: Prospective pan-cancer phosphoproteomics at clinical scale extends therapeutic options in precision oncology
source_candidate.reported_scope: 1,998 patient tumors in MASTER/CATCH/INFORM; 46 kinase TOPAS scores; no EMC identity or measurement values yet established

claim_to_test: Among all independently source-authenticated patient EMC specimens in this release, is RET activation measurable beyond the previously reported RET RNA abundance, relative to fixed myxoid liposarcoma and synovial-sarcoma patient specimens assayed in compatible batches?
prior_art: RET expression in EMC and RET-linked clinical agents are established prior evidence; the new source authors report kinase scoring and sarcoma pazopanib stratification. Neither is a new EMC-specific result. Prior R1-R8 bulk expression screens are reused, not rediscovered. The full primary source must be checked for an already reported EMC RET contrast before any new finding is promoted.
primary_assay: If publicly released, uniquely RET-assigned phosphopeptides at canonical activating Y905 and/or Y1062 with matched total RET measurement; report each site separately. Prespecified phosphorylation/total-protein contrast is only identifiable where numerator and denominator are both measured without imputed absence. Published RET TOPAS score, if present, is a separate substrate-based supporting readout and cannot substitute for direct site measurement.
fixed_scope: RET only; no exploratory selection among 46 kinases
All patient-linked authenticated EMC conditions, including repeated/metastatic/treated samples, remain in coverage
Fixed primary comparators: myxoid liposarcoma and synovial sarcoma; low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma as descriptive contrary context if source-linked available
Patient/donor unit for inference; specimens retained individually; unknown donor overlap forbids independence claims
Normal tissue context retained if assayed and anatomically interpretable; absence of matched normal is a limitation, not tumor specificity
authentication: Primary pathology explicitly EMC or extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma plus source molecular authentication where available. Generic myxoid chondrosarcoma, SARC codes, disputed cell models, or cohort abbreviations cannot be transferred to EMC; fusion/diagnostic metadata used for eligibility only, not structural-genomic mechanism analysis.
strongest_alternatives: High RNA/total RET without receptor activation
RET substrate score driven by promiscuous kinases, no uniquely measured RET phosphosite
Tumor purity, non-neoplastic/stromal neural or vascular compartments, tissue mixture and site composition
Protein loading, platform/batch, phosphoenrichment sensitivity and pre-analytical handling
Treatment or sampling-site differences and repeated-donor pseudoreplication
A lineage-wide signal also present in relevant myxoid/other sarcoma comparators
analysis_gate: Freeze source hash/case roster/eligible assay rows before values. Use all eligible EMC observations. Summarize per-case direct-site and matched total-protein measurements, censoring/missingness and within-batch effect direction. Only estimate patient-level contrast if source denominators and sufficient independent patient comparators justify it. No generic post-hoc significant screen or optimized cutoff. Two direct sites are separate named outcomes; uncertainty and both unfavorable outcomes retained.
useful_addition: A reproducible, source-authenticated direct phosphorylation contrast could prioritize a bounded tissue assay for RET activation beyond RNA. Bulk phosphoproteomics does not establish accessible protein, receptor dependency, drug sensitivity or patient benefit.
defeat_or_stop: No publicly released direct RET sites with matched total RET or valid distinct useful supporting assay
Source authors already report the same EMC-specific contrast
Missing donor/batch/comparator linkage makes a purported new contrast uninterpretable
All direct measurements unfavorable, too sparse or discordant across conditions
Suitable accessible evidence left pending blocks promotion
storage: Read-only shared inputs; new raw source soft cap 64 MiB and >=10 GiB free. Larger informative source requires exact finite lead-approved stage. No browser/UI/image inspection during NY06-10 ban.
prospective_status: Frozen before any numerical EMC values in the new phosphoproteomic source. Source eligibility remains pending; this is a conditional question, not an assertion that EMC is present.
